title:
Every delivery.
Every unit.
Accounted for.
subtitle: Consignment Ledger
tag: A project walkthrough by John Kenneth Cañete
narration: When fresh produce leaves the warehouse, the work is only half done. On consignment, a delivery is not yet a sale. E F P Supply Chain keeps those numbers connected.
captions: When fresh produce leaves the warehouse, the work is only half done.
On consignment, a delivery is not yet a sale.
EFP Supply Chain keeps those numbers connected.

title:
Start with
what needs
attention.
subtitle: A live view of warehouse activity
narration: The dashboard brings stock levels, upcoming expiry dates, and unresolved discrepancies into one view. Deliveries by branch and recent movements show where the stock is going.
captions: The dashboard brings stock levels, upcoming expiry dates,
and unresolved discrepancies into one view.
Deliveries by branch and recent movements show where the stock is going.

title:
Know the batch.
Watch the
expiry date.
subtitle: Products linked to production batches
narration: Each production batch has its own number and expiry date. Remaining quantities stay visible, so staff can check which batch is available before recording the next delivery.
captions: Each production batch has its own number and expiry date.
Remaining quantities stay visible, so staff can check
which batch is available before recording the next delivery.

title:
Stock in.
Delivery out.
Loss recorded.
subtitle: One history of warehouse stock changes
narration: Production adds stock. Deliveries reduce it. Warehouse and transit losses are recorded separately. Every movement keeps the product, quantity, and responsible user together, with delivery references where needed.
captions: Production adds stock. Deliveries reduce it.
Warehouse and transit losses are recorded separately.
Every movement keeps the product, quantity, and responsible user together,
with delivery references where needed.

title:
Delivered
isn’t the same
as sold.
subtitle: Compare branch sales against deliveries
narration: Reconciliation compares the delivery with the branch's reported sales. Fifteen delivered and thirteen sold leaves two units to resolve. Accounting can document a write off or correct an entry, keeping the reason on record.
captions: Reconciliation compares the delivery with the branch’s reported sales.
Fifteen delivered and thirteen sold leaves two units to resolve.
Accounting can document a write-off or correct an entry,
keeping the reason on record.

title:
The right tools.

right people.
subtitle: Roles for warehouse, sales, and accounting
tag: Role-based access • A recorded audit trail
narration: Warehouse, sales, and accounting have different permissions. The audit log records who changed what, making stock decisions easier to trace when questions come up.
